description: No charge. Revise an owned draft's text, font, size, optional color and page limit and optional format settings and letterhead:{id,version} (or null to remove) using its current version. format controls printed fields, greeting/signature, reply cleanup, spacing/margins/page numbers; omitted format/color/letterhead/maxPages preserves the draft's settings. body may be empty. A supplied format fills unspecified fields with defaults, so merge existing settings first to change just one option. Color adds $0.49 for each page; site previews are grayscale when false. Production key required. Renders a new immutable PDF and increments version; always requires fresh review and approval. Cannot edit submitted, uncertain or rejected letters.

body.description: Required, but may be empty to clear the printed body. The original EML is preserved.

format.description: Omit to preserve the draft format. When supplied, omitted format fields use their defaults; this is not a partial patch.

letterhead.description: Omit to preserve the pinned revision; null removes stationery; a reference selects that exact active owned revision.
